newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan to host Pacific economic conference in May.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to host Pacific economic conference in May.

text.p: Taiwan, pushing to expand its international profile in the face of China's diplomatic embargo, said on Tuesday it would host an economic conference of Pacific Basin nations in May.
The finance ministry said Taipei would host the seventh financial markets development project meeting of the regional Pacific Economic Cooperation Committee.
The semi-official regional committee was set up in 1980 and groups officials, executives and academics in the Pacific basin, the ministry said in a statement.
Taiwan joined the organisation in 1986 under the name Chinese Taipei and has participated actively, it said.

China, which has regarded Taiwan as a rebel province since a civil war split them in 1949, seeks to isolate the island from the world diplomatic arena but allows it to join unofficial economic organisations as a non-sovereign customs territory.
